tagline: KMZ胶片单反相机，1960 年发布
description: KMZ于1960年推出的胶片单反相机。配备Industar-50 50mm f/3.5。快门速度rubberized silk double cloth curtain, horizontal-travel。使用bottom loading, w/ special removable take up spool; film should be cut with a 100mm leader.。fixed pentaprism with plain ground-glass screen。

specs.对焦: fixed pentaprism with plain ground-glass screen
specs.快门: rubberized silk double cloth curtain, horizontal-travel
specs.闪光灯: on the front of the top-plate, only activates at 1/30 speed
specs.胶片/画幅: bottom loading, w/ special removable take up spool; film should be cut with a 100mm leader.
